points.point: Is the 5-hashtag error a Blotato bug or an Instagram rule?
points.sentence: This is a Blotato guardrail, not an Instagram rule.

points.point: Instagram allows 30 hashtags, so why the 5 cap?
points.sentence: Instagram itself allows more hashtags, but Blotato caps posts at 5 on purpose because more than 5 hashtags reduces your reach on Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.

points.point: How to get the post published
points.sentence: Fix: trim your caption to 5 hashtags or fewer and republish.

verdict.reason: This entry says the 5-hashtag cap is an intentional Blotato guardrail, not an Instagram rule or a bug. It also gives the fix of trimming the caption to 5 hashtags or fewer.
